name: Ferienwohnung Lisa
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated in the charming Haflinger village of Ebbs, Ferienwohnung Lisa welcomes visitors with contemporary comfort and a friendly atmosphere, complete with a balcony.

The Fohlenhof stud farm, trailheads into the Kaiser valley, and cycling along the Inn are all quickly accessible.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Lisa in Ebbs offers modern holiday living at the foot of the Zahmer Kaiser in Kufsteinerland.
